Document ID: SOP-FOCUSED-EN
Revision: 1
Source hash: 9c5155b3ecc53def260d107d2f8ed25515e46b2dc7b8209e340e78be8db791ee

Passage ID: containment
Page: 1
For a supplier notice, retain the original and verify the exact affected lot list and complete incident boundary. Keep unresolved ancestry uncertain. An operator must inspect every critical source assertion before a deterministic containment plan can be approved.

Passage ID: recovery
Page: 1
Before release or recovery, recorded receiving evidence must resolve the relevant ancestry and the applicable quality condition. A separate authorized approver is required. A source citation, model answer or narrower proposed hold never releases existing applied holds.
